label: Brain
shortExplain: 🧠 The brain is the boss of your body! It sends messages for everything you do.
detailedExplain: 🧠 The brain controls your whole body by sending millions of messages along nerves. It helps you think, dream, move, and feel emotions.

label: Heart
shortExplain: ❤️ Thump-thump, thump-thump! Your heart beats non-stop and sends blood all around your body.
detailedExplain: ❤️ The heart is a muscle that pumps blood through tubes called blood vessels, carrying oxygen and energy to every part of your body.

label: Lungs
shortExplain: 🫁 Your lungs fill up with air when you breathe, like two balloons.
detailedExplain: 🫁 The lungs bring oxygen from the air into your blood and release the carbon dioxide your body doesn't need, every time you breathe.

label: Skeleton
shortExplain: 🦴 Your bones make up your skeleton, which gives your body its shape and support.
detailedExplain: 🦴 Your skeleton has more than 200 bones that give you structure, protect important organs like your heart and brain, and work with your muscles to help you move.

label: Muscles
shortExplain: 💪 Muscles help you run, jump, and smile!
detailedExplain: 💪 Muscles stretch and squeeze to move your bones, and even make your heart beat and food move down in your tummy.

label: Digestion
shortExplain: 🍽️ When you eat, food goes to your tummy, which turns it into energy.
detailedExplain: 🍽️ Your digestive system breaks food down into tiny pieces your body can use for energy, starting in your mouth and passing through your stomach and intestines.

label: Skin
shortExplain: 🧴 Your skin covers your whole body and protects you, like a cape.
detailedExplain: 🧴 Skin is the biggest organ in your body! It protects you from germs and sun, and feels things like touch, heat, and cold.

label: Blood
shortExplain: 🩸 Blood travels all around your body, carrying food and air to your cells.
detailedExplain: 🩸 Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to every part of your body, and helps fight off germs that get in.
